answer_1.quote: CommonGen is a constrained text generation task, with the goal of generating a coherent and plausible sentence s describing an everyday scenario using an unordered concept set c = {c1 , c2 . . . , cm } … We conduct experiments on the CommonGen dataset ... We use BART-base as the generation model and also compare with GPT-2, BERT-Gen, UniLM, T5, KG-BART, EKI-BART, RE‑T5, KFCNet, KGR.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences describing everyday scenarios based on input concept sets

answer_2.quote: We resort to BLUE, ROUGE, and METEOR to measure the surface similarities between the generated sentences and human references. In addition, we use CIDEr and SPICE to evaluate the generated sentences.
